for.description: Optional: add this row for one signed-in visitor instead of running sql, on a table whose read is own (records, personal only; refused for_requires_own elsewhere) — a visitor reference (storage_visitor_emails, or a row's visitor_id) or the email they signed in with. Requires table and values in place of sql and params. Refused visitor_unknown if they have never signed in on this site (resolve or check first with storage_visitor_emails if unsure), or visitor_email_ambiguous if more than one signed-in person currently matches that email (use their reference instead). The row is stamped written by you, is visible to that visitor as yours rather than theirs, and does not notify your own subscriptions; a table's own trigger that fights that is caught and the whole add rolled back (written_by_tampered) rather than shipped half right. Available to account owners.
